workingStyle.title: How I Work
workingStyle.subtitle: Beyond technical skill, how I approach the work.
workingStyle.problemSolving.title: Problem Solving
workingStyle.problemSolving.body: I break complex requirements into small, testable pieces and move step by step, getting feedback at each stage to sharpen direction.
workingStyle.collaboration.title: Collaboration & Communication
workingStyle.collaboration.body: Working as a team with Git, clear documentation, and regular feedback loops are an inseparable part of the job for me.
workingStyle.codeQuality.title: Code Quality
workingStyle.codeQuality.body: I care about writing readable, maintainable code, avoiding unnecessary complexity, and reusing what already exists.
workingStyle.learning.title: Continuous Learning
workingStyle.learning.body: I like trying a new technology on a small project first, to understand its limits before bringing it into production.
features.architecture.title: System Architecture
features.architecture.body: I build scalable, sustainable architectures on Vercel and Supabase, delivering production-ready systems with clean API design and automated deployment pipelines.
features.iot.title: IoT & Embedded Systems
features.iot.body: I connect the physical world to software with Arduino, ESP8266 and Raspberry Pi: building sensor data pipelines, motion detection and real-time monitoring systems.
features.fullstack.title: Full Stack Development
features.fullstack.body: I build end-to-end web apps with React and Node.js, covering every layer from REST API design to PostgreSQL/Supabase database modeling.
features.data.title: Data & Artificial Intelligence
features.data.body: I train deep learning models with Python, turning raw data into meaningful insights and production-ready prediction models.
focus.quote: I'm an engineer who loves building end to end: from interface to database, from IoT to artificial intelligence.
focus.scopeBody: I build systems that stretch from IoT sensor networks to web and mobile interfaces, working with real-world data.
focus.approachBody: I ship in small, working pieces and get feedback early; readability matters to me as much as the code itself.
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Computer Engineering graduate from Hitit University. I build projects that stretch from artificial intelligence and machine learning to IoT, from mobile apps to the web — with a particular focus on growing in IoT, full stack and data.

about.timeline.saski.heading: SASKİ — Mobile Developer Intern
about.timeline.saski.desc: Built a zoo mobile app with React Native and Expo; integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore.
about.timeline.hubtuam.heading: HÜBTUAM — Engineering Intern
about.timeline.hubtuam.desc: Developed an IoT poultry monitoring system with Arduino, ESP8266 and Raspberry Pi 5; implemented OpenCV motion detection with chicken & egg counting, and integrated a Flutter app with Firebase.
